tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Dock background behind every card. Never put text directly on it except `ink-muted` section labels.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards: account header, room card, settings groups, popovers.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Inputs, list rows on hover, secondary buttons, the QR well frame.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Read-only wells: stream key field, skeleton placeholders.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows and around cards. Decorative only — never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, toggles off, secondary buttons). Holds 3:1 on `surface` and `surface-raised` in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on `canvas`, `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, metadata, section labels; on any surface (≥6:1).

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholders and disabled labels; still ≥4.5:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Kaibo Rose. The Go Live button fill, the logo tile, the live lamp. White text on it (`on-brand`) holds 4.7:1. Use once per view.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of `brand` buttons.

tokens.name: brand-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed fill of `brand` buttons.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `brand`, `brand-hover`, `brand-pressed`.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: Brand as text or icon on surfaces and on `brand-soft`: links, the LIVE word, selected chips.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind live status pills and the selected area row.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text/icons: saved, logged in, OBS streaming healthy. Teal, off the red–green axis, always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind success pills and toasts.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning text/icons: state mismatch banners (room open but OBS not streaming), expiring QR.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind warning banners.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions (End live, Sign out). Orange so it never reads as the rose `brand`; always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind error banners and toasts.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral notices and inline links in help text.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px keyboard focus ring on every interactive control; ≥4.7:1 on all surfaces.

tokens.name: qr-ground
tokens.usage: Quiet zone behind QR codes. Always white so phone cameras scan in both themes.

tokens.name: qr-ink
tokens.usage: QR modules on `qr-ground`.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay behind the QR expired/scanned states and modal sheets.

families.sans: "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "PingFang TC", "Microsoft YaHei UI", "Microsoft JhengHei UI", "Noto Sans CJK SC", system-ui, sans-serif
families.mono: "Cascadia Mono", "JetBrains Mono", "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The live timer only. Tabular numerals.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Field labels, list row primary text, button labels.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: 开播后自动开始 OBS 推流

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Metadata, hints under fields, toast secondary line.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Status pills and section labels on `canvas`.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Server URL and the masked stream key.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, pill padding block.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls; list row padding block.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between fields in a card.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between cards; dock outer padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Empty-state and login sheet breathing room.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, chips, list rows, the key field.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, buttons, banners, popovers.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The Go Live button and the QR well — the two things the dock is for.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills, toggles, avatar.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Icon buttons, chips, compact rows.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, secondary buttons, list rows.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: The Go Live / End live button.

tokens.name: avatar
tokens.usage: Account avatar in the header.

tokens.name: qr
tokens.usage: QR code edge, including the white quiet zone.

tokens.name: dock-min
tokens.usage: Minimum dock width; layouts must not clip above it.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Popovers (area picker, overflow menu) and toasts only. Cards are flat, separated by `line`.
